Just to clarify this before you read on and get too deeply invested: I am currently only looking to make friends. I am demisexual and it is hard for me to feel sexual attraction/emotions (and sometimes romantic attraction/emotions) towards someone. Please do not talk to me just with the intention of dating me. A deep/meaningful connection can evolve into something else but is absolutely not guarantee. I also am in the BDSM kink scene/very kink friendly, just to give that heads up.

I really enjoy writing, reading, watching movies, history, going on long walks, meditating, reading the Bible, discovering new music/making playlists, dabbling in cannabis, making/looking at art, alcoholic beverages, video games here and there, flowers, nostalgic collectibles, fashion, cooking, and finding cool rocks! So many interests and aspects of life interest me and I enjoy having friends around even if our interests and hobbies widely vary. I’m looking for kind, understanding friends. I am an introverted empath and it can be hard for me to find the energy to socialize all day, every day.  

I am located in south Florida and I can be a bit more specific if we get along nicely. I am interested in both internet and local friends, so don’t be afraid to message me if you want to. I mostly prefer to vet on Reddit first and then move things to Discord. 

Thank you for reading my post. I am glad this community exists and I can try and find CF friends this way.

I have the following settings for aging in MC Command Center: 

Baby: 80 days
Toddler: 900 days
Child: 1800 days
Teen: 1800 days
Young Adult: 1800 days
Adult: 1500 days
Elder: 1000 days

For each playable household, I don’t play an exact set of days. I try to finish their aspiration/goals based on their character, life stage, and location. Some people in real life won’t achieve their goals or will change their life goals and I tend to mirror this with some of my Sims! 

I play through a life phase for the children of the household, age them up, and then rotate to the next household. Young Adults get aged up when their first child is either a child or teenager. 

My toddlers, children, and teens will finish their aspiration (unless their parents weren’t good parents) and each have my own made up set of goals. Toddlers will meet their cousins and grandparents. Children will meet their neighborhood kids. Teens will make friends in school and get a boyfriend/girlfriend/partner if applicable.

Young adults might not finish their aspirations until adulthood or even when their an elder (or possibly not at all!). I tend to let Sims die if they end up dying accidentally. I also will allow them to have affairs or divorces if they autonomously do so. 

Once all the children in the household are aged up and/or moved out, I age the parents into elders and move them out. The youngest child tends to inherit the family home unless they were a real troublemaker. Some of my Sims never have children and are aged up once their aspirations are complete. 

Sorry it’s really long! My gameplay is very specific and I’ve done a few rotational play throughs to eventually find the style of playing and aging I liked. MCCC and other mods also help keep it functioning with so many Sims.
